backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing backend logic for events, tree adoption, user participation tracking, and serving two hardcoded blog posts about arid soil planting and mycorrhizae.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping seven implemented features (hero, crisis, solution, volunteer portal, blog, etc.) to their corresponding frontend files and test IDs with high confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the Algeria reforestation website's components, styling, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles with custom OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode color tokens for the design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference for the React application titled 'Restoring Algeria's Green Heart'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component rendering the full single-page application with Header, nine content sections (Hero through Blog), and Footer.
frontend/src/components/Blog.tsx: Educational blog component that displays two article cards and fetches full blog post content from the backend actor using React Query when selected.
frontend/src/components/Crisis.tsx: Crisis section component displaying four deforestation factors (wildfires, climatic stress, human impact, soil erosion) with icons, statistics, and imagery in a grid layout.
frontend/src/components/ExecutiveSummary: Displays an overview of Algeria's ecological challenge with three cards highlighting geographic diversity, current forest cover (4.1M hectares), and the dual mission of protection and expansion.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand information, quick navigation links, social media icons, and copyright notice.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed header component with logo, site title, and navigation buttons that smooth-scroll to different page sections.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with background image of Atlas Mountains, headline about restoring Algeria's forests, and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/components/NationalPlan.tsx: Presents Algeria's National Reforestation Plan with three cards covering goals, timeline, and focus species, plus a list of priority tree species.
frontend/src/components/Solution.tsx: Showcases the Green Dam project with aerial imagery and four stat cards detailing its scale (1,500km x 20km), history, and climate impact.
Displays three key forest species (Aleppo Pine, Atlas Cedar, Cork Oak) with images, badges, and descriptions of their ecological and economic importance.
frontend/src/components/UrbanGreening.ts: React component displaying information about Algeria's urban greening initiative, including green ratio laws, heat island mitigation, and focus cities like Algiers and Oran. Uses Lucide icons and styled cards to present the content.
React component providing a volunteer portal with tabs for signing up to planting events and adopting trees. Uses React Query mutations to interact with the backend actor and displays toast notifications for user feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity status. Invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle. Provides context for authentication status and identity access throughout the app.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for the design system using OKLCH color space. Includes theme colors (forest green, desert sand), light/dark mode variants, and custom scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (forest-green, desert-sand), OKLCH color system integration, container settings, and animation keyframes. Includes typography and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project configuration for an Algerian reforestation awareness website featuring the Green Dam project, crisis information, volunteer portal, and educational content. Defines architectural notes including color scheme (Deep Forest Green/Desert Sand), multi-language support, SEO keywords, and lists existing features covering hero section, crisis explanation, Green Dam solution, volunteer portal, educational blog, native species showcase, and impact statistics dashboard.
